name: Lauren Bousfield
description: '''Lauren Bousfield''' is an [[electronic musician]], composer, and [[sound designer]] based in [[Los Angeles]]. She initially gained recognition for her project '''Nero's Day at Disneyland''', and has since released music under her own name, and as part of the duos In-House Pharmacy and DOOR EATER. Bousfield also composes music for television, film, and video games.
